<?php
/**
 * Message Queue Consumer for processing user upload notifications
 * Handles file metadata extraction and redirect generation for CDN routing
 */

namespace App\Queue\Consumers;

use App\Services\UrlValidator;
use App\Services\CdnRouter;
use App\Models\UploadRecord;

class UploadNotificationConsumer
{
    private array $trustedDomains = [
        'cdn.example.com',
        'assets.example.com',
        'media.example.com',
        'storage.example.internal'
    ];

    private array $allowedSchemes = ['https'];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly CdnRouter $cdnRouter,
        private readonly UrlValidator $validator
    ) {}

    /**
     * Process incoming upload notification from the message queue
     */
    public function handle(array $message): array
    {
        $uploadId = $message['upload_id'] ?? null;
        $metadata = $message['metadata'] ?? [];
        $callbackUrl = $message['callback_url'] ?? null;

        if (!$uploadId || !is_string($uploadId)) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'invalid_upload_id'];
        }

        // Validate upload exists and extract processing result
        $record = $this->resolveUploadRecord($uploadId);
        if (!$record) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'upload_not_found'];
        }

        // Process the file metadata from the upload
        $processedMeta = $this->extractAndValidateMetadata($metadata, $record);

        // Generate the CDN redirect URL for the processed asset
        $redirectUrl = $this->buildAssetRedirectUrl($record, $processedMeta);

        // If a callback URL was provided, validate and store it
        if ($callbackUrl !== null) {
            $redirectUrl = $this->resolveCallbackRedirect($callbackUrl, $redirectUrl);
        }

        return [
            'status' => 'processed',
            'upload_id' => $uploadId,
            'redirect_url' => $redirectUrl,
            'metadata' => $processedMeta
        ];
    }

    private function resolveUploadRecord(string $uploadId): ?UploadRecord
    {
        // Simulate DB lookup - in production this queries the uploads table
        if (preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/', $uploadId)) {
            $record = new UploadRecord();
            $record->id = $uploadId;
            $record->bucket = 'user-uploads';
            $record->region = 'us-east-1';
            return $record;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function extractAndValidateMetadata(array $metadata, UploadRecord $record): array
    {
        $allowed = ['content_type', 'size', 'checksum', 'original_name', 'dimensions'];
        $filtered = array_intersect_key($metadata, array_flip($allowed));

        // Sanitize string values
        return array_map(function ($value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                return htmlspecialchars($value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            }
            if (is_array($value)) {
                return array_map('intval', $value);
            }
            return $value;
        }, $filtered);
    }

    /**
     * Build the CDN redirect URL from the upload record and metadata
     */
    private function buildAssetRedirectUrl(UploadRecord $record, array $metadata): string
    {
        $baseCdn = 'https://cdn.example.com';
        $path = sprintf('/assets/%s/%s/%s',
            urlencode($record->region),
            urlencode($record->bucket),
            urlencode($record->id)
        );
        return $baseCdn . $path;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve callback redirect - merges callback with CDN URL
     * The callback URL undergoes domain validation before use
     */
    private function resolveCallbackRedirect(string $callbackUrl, string $cdnUrl): string
    {
        // Validate the raw URL against trusted domains BEFORE any transformation
        if (!$this->isUrlTrusted($callbackUrl)) {
            // Untrusted callback - fall back to CDN URL
            return $cdnUrl;
        }

        // Only normalize after validation passes on the raw input
        $normalized = $this->normalizeUrl($callbackUrl);

        // Re-validate after normalization to prevent bypass
        if (!$this->isUrlTrusted($normalized)) {
            return $cdnUrl;
        }

        // Append the CDN path as a query parameter to the callback
        $separator = (parse_url($normalized, PHP_URL_QUERY) !== null) ? '&' : '?';
        return $normalized . $separator . 'asset_url=' . urlencode($cdnUrl);
    }

    /**
     * Normalize URL for consistent handling
     */
    private function normalizeUrl(string $url): string
    {
        // Remove any null bytes
        $cleaned = str_replace("\0", '', $url);

        // Normalize backslashes to forward slashes
        $cleaned = str_replace('\\', '/', $cleaned);

        return $cleaned;
    }

    /**
     * Check if URL belongs to a trusted domain
     */
    private function isUrlTrusted(string $url): bool
    {
        $parsed = parse_url($url);

        if ($parsed === false || !isset($parsed['scheme']) || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Verify scheme
        if (!in_array(strtolower($parsed['scheme']), $this->allowedSchemes, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $host = strtolower($parsed['host']);

        // Check against trusted domains - exact match only, no subdomain wildcarding
        foreach ($this->trustedDomains as $trusted) {
            if ($host === $trusted) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }
}

// Supporting classes (minimal stubs for context)
namespace App\Models;
class UploadRecord {
    public string $id;
    public string $bucket;
    public string $region;
}

namespace App\Services;
class UrlValidator {}
class CdnRouter {}
